verdict.rationale: Formant documents a data-export path: data scientists can query telemetry programmatically through the Python Cloud SDK against the query API, so data can be pulled out. Nothing shows a complete export of all account data, the file formats involved, or offboarding. Missing for 10: bulk export of all data (not just telemetry queries), documented open export formats (e.g. CSV/Parquet/MCAP), account offboarding or exit process, independent or hands-on corroboration.
